title: GigCapital7 Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: GigCapital7 Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K on April 16, 2026 disclosing a Second Amendment to its Business Combination Agreement with Hadron Energy, Inc., which reduces the company's valuation from $1 billion to $600 million and extends the outside date from April 30, 2026 to May 31, 2026. The SPAC also issued an amended and restated working capital note of $293,000 to its sponsor.
key_points: Second Amendment to Business Combination Agreement executed on April 16, 2026
Public Company (Pre-Capital Raise) Valuation reduced from $1,200,200,000 to $776,599,997
Aggregate Merger Consideration reduced from 100,000,000 to 60,000,000 shares of Domesticated Purchaser Common Stock
Company valuation effectively reduced from $1 billion to $600 million at $10.00 nominal share value
Outside Date extended from April 30, 2026 to May 31, 2026
Amended and Restated Working Capital Note of $293,000 issued to sponsor GigAcquisitions7 Corp.
